description: One resumable production run of E3-SSE: ESTIMATE -> DIAGNOSE -> CORRECT OR ABSTAIN -> SELECT -> DISCOVER. Scientific rules come from the active protocol; this file binds inputs, stage order and evidence locations. resource_policy and resource_profiling are operational and never enter the run identity.

runtime.note: model_runtime_root matches configs/study1_softening_atlas.json; on aiserver it resolves to /home/soft/.venvs for the account that created the frozen environments. tmpdir is resolved against outputs_root and keeps temporary files off the RAM-backed /tmp.

freeze.note: existing_binding null: the freeze stage materializes the internal freeze from the clean HEAD after preflight passes; once a freeze exists and the code moves on, pin it here as {protocol_id, file_sha256, directory}. require_outcome_runners_implemented true: the freeze waits until every outcome-reading stage has a tested runner, so no analysis code is written after outcomes are seen; setting it false is a declared deviation recorded with the run.

resource_policy.rationale: The reserve is the larger of 2.5 GiB and 12% of RAM (orchestrator, page cache, load spikes); swap is never capacity. Peak RSS is planned at 1.35x the measured VmHWM. NUMA pinning is not applied: the memory budget, not memory bandwidth, bounds concurrency on this host, and placement never changes results.

stages.name: runtime_audit
stages.description: ASE/FIRE/NEB identity and frozen-settings acceptance audit in every frozen model runtime (no data, no model).

stages.name: resource_profile
stages.description: Measured worker memory and process x thread throughput per model for force single points and the ML-NEB band, on geometry-only structures.

stages.name: gate1_population_audit
stages.description: Outcome-free structural bookkeeping at d = 3 (evidence for open items rate_limiting_hop_algorithm and prospective_gate1_rule): unique normalized chemical systems of the rate-limiting hops in nebDFT2k, one structure per system, published-split classes. Upper bounds, never a population manifest.

stages.name: bvse_reproduction
stages.description: Frozen BVSE initial-path generator and its reproduction of nebDFT2k _init.xyz.
stages.next_task: Inspect the ions package on aiserver, pin its version (open items ions_bvse_version_pin, bvse_reproduction), and implement an outcome-free audit that regenerates the BVSE path (Decorator, collect_bvse_params(Li,+1), Percolator(upper_bound=8.0), mincut_maxdim(tr=0.5), superedge(8.0).interpolate(n_images=5)) for every nebDFT2k calibration hop and compares it with <edge_id>_init.xyz (atom count/order identical, cell within 1e-4 A, positions within 0.01 A); report the reproduction rate and decorator failures separately.

stages.name: descriptor_availability
stages.description: Source-field availability of the label-free descriptor set.
stages.next_task: data-engineer server audit (open item descriptor_availability): for every feature in amendments.prospective.support_gate.descriptor_space and configs/descriptor_fallback_manifest.json, record the source field and the per-population missing/finite counts on the G0-audited nebDFT2k, nebBVSE122k and BVEL13k schemas (table R_descriptor_availability). Report no feature value.

stages.name: development_population
stages.description: Hashed development population (identifiers only).
stages.next_task: Build the development manifest (open item development_manifest): published-test chemical systems with nebDFT2k hops, spanning systems excluded, Gate 0 (TM/Hubbard-U plus the nebDFT2k element criteria, which must first be written down as code), one structure per system by structure_rule, its h*_3 if that hop is a nebDFT2k hop; hash it into amendments.prospective.development_manifest_sha256 before any development outcome.

stages.name: development_ml_neb
stages.description: Converged ML-NEB bands of the development population; geometry source for the path representation.
stages.next_task: Shard development hops x models with e3sse.execution (one shard per hop and model) and run e3sse.barriers.ml_neb.run_ml_neb in each model's frozen runtime on the frozen BVSE paths. Use the per-model dtype from amendments.prospective.ml_neb.runtime_requirements.dtype (ml_neb.frozen_model_dtype) and the run-pinned thread count, and pass the provenance block. Store band geometries and classified failures, and run the 20-hop reproducibility subset and the LiTraj-exact development-only sensitivity. Outcome-free: no DFT barrier is read.

stages.name: path_representation
stages.description: Per-model path-level representation and its label-free acceptance.
stages.next_task: Extract the pinned per-image migrating-Li embeddings on the development bands, build z_path by amendments.representation.path_representation.mapping_rule, evaluate the four acceptance criteria (including the LOCSO k-NN CV >= 0.05 and tau_d bootstrap CV <= 0.10 degeneracy checks) and record per model which branch applies (open item path_representation_mapping).

stages.name: preflight
stages.description: Aggregate every blocking outcome-free evidence item (Git, data hashes, Gate 1, embeddings, checkpoints, locks, runtimes, ASE/NEB audits, resource profiles, protocol open items, output safety).

stages.name: freeze
stages.description: Materialize (or bind) the frozen internal-freeze protocol from the reviewed clean commit; grants outcome access to later stages.

stages.name: estimate
stages.description: Study-1 softening estimates (Eq. 17), cluster bootstrap, label budget, diagnostics, tables and figures for all six frozen models.

stages.name: family_scale
stages.description: Family softening scales for the deployed predictor.
stages.next_task: Compute the pooled family-scope s (amendments.prospective.s_scope: MPLiTrj frames of training-side chemical systems without nebDFT2k hops) once per model with the Study-1 sufficient-statistics code, and publish it as a hashed artifact that model selection, deployment calibration and discovery read; no later stage reads these forces directly.

stages.name: transfer
stages.description: Raw and SRT-corrected fixed-geometry barriers, paired effects and the P1 endpoint.
stages.next_task: Implement the Study-2a runner: fixed-geometry single points of every frozen model on the DFT-NEB images of the evaluation hops (sharded by model x hop), material-scope s from leakage-eligible non-path frames (test-side non-path forces), methods B0-B4 and the B6 oracle (labelled, never primary) per amendments.transfer_benchmark via e3sse.barriers.fixed_geometry, the deployment-gate thresholds, element-resolved SRT, label_budget_downstream and the explicit G1 decision file; B5 runs in linear_recalibration_comparator after model selection.

stages.name: reliability
stages.description: Risk-coverage, AURC and correct-or-abstain behaviour of the pre-outcome diagnostics.
stages.next_task: Drive e3sse.softening.applicability and e3sse.selection.selective_prediction over the transfer records: rho_F and the other frozen scores, risk-coverage, AURC with the analytic random baseline, both framings, the chemical-system cluster bootstrap and the P4/H6 Holm family.

stages.name: weight_slice_ml_neb
stages.description: Per-model ML-NEB on the frozen held-out weight-fit slices.
stages.next_task: Blocked by open item weight_slice_definition_order: once the frozen P and Q weight-fit slices are defined before per-model convergence, run every model's ML-NEB on the slice units (outcome-free), giving the independent support coverage that model selection needs and the converged slices that density_ratio fits on.

stages.name: model_selection
stages.description: Frozen development-set selection of the deployed model.
stages.next_task: Score the complete deployed predictor on the per-system rate-limiting development hops with e3sse.screening.prospective_contract.select_prospective_model (coverage on the label-free Q weight-fit slice, G1 decision from transfer); access development barriers only through the pinned development manifest; never report the winner's development MAE as a performance estimate.

stages.name: deployment_calibration
stages.description: Calibration-side ML-NEB with the deployed predictor (no label read).
stages.next_task: Run e3sse.barriers.ml_neb.run_ml_neb (selected model, frozen BVSE paths, frozen dtype, run-pinned threads) on every conformal-calibration hop excluding the weight-fit slice, apply the support gate and family SRT, and record converged/failed (classified, never retried) and supported/abstained units, plus relaxed_path_comparison. Outcome-free (draw -> run -> drop): calibration labels are read only in discovery_selection.

stages.name: linear_recalibration_comparator
stages.description: Label-using comparator, kept after model selection.
stages.next_task: Fit B5 (amendments.transfer_benchmark.methods.B5_linear_recalibration) on the training-partition barriers and evaluate it on the transfer hops. It runs after model selection because those barriers belong to the conformal-calibration systems.

stages.name: controlled_selection
stages.description: Retrospective conformal FDR validity and power.
stages.next_task: Run the Study-4 retrospective conformal validity and power analysis under every unchanged parent study_4_contract rule (draws, seeds, alpha, c, MC s.e., the parent deterministic tie break, BH with BY sensitivity) with the added SRT_gated_correct_or_raw predictor (amendments.selection).

stages.name: density_ratio
stages.description: Density-ratio weights for weighted conformal selection.
stages.next_task: Fit the L2-regularized logistic domain classifier (e3sse.selection.density_ratio, IRLS, no clipping) on the converged held-out P and Q slices of the selected model; report AUC, ESS, max weight, overlap and the share of never-selectable units. Label-free.

stages.name: discovery
stages.description: Prospective pool predictions.
stages.next_task: BVEL13k -> normalized chemical systems -> one structure per system -> d = 3 rate-limiting hop -> frozen BVSE path -> ML-NEB (selected model, frozen dtype, run-pinned threads) -> support gate -> raw/SRT prediction; record the funnel with e3sse.screening.prospective_contract.funnel, keeping ML-NEB failure and support abstention separate. No label exists or is read.

stages.name: discovery_selection
stages.description: Controlled prospective selection and candidate evidence.
stages.next_task: Weighted conformalized selection (e3sse.selection.conformal.weighted_conformalized_selection, published focal weight w_j, lexicographic (score, tie_key) with the SHA-256 tie key, deterministic conservative sensitivity) on the predictor-eligible population, then the candidate evidence package. Candidates are screening results with approximate FDR control, not confirmed superionic conductors.

stages.name: publication
stages.description: Registered publication figures and tables with provenance.
stages.next_task: Build every registered figure/table of configs/figure_registry.json and configs/table_registry.json from the derived tables only (Seaborn + Matplotlib object-oriented API via e3sse.figures.publication_style.export_figure: PDF + 600-dpi PNG + provenance JSON). The ESTIMATE figures already exist (built inside the estimate stage).
